steps.title: Crundi remembers
steps.body: One memory across everything: the conversation carries on after a restart, a notebook keeps your preferences and standing facts, and Crundi can find anything said before, by keyword or by meaning. Read and edit the notebook on the voice page.

steps.title: Talk to Crundi from the top bar
steps.body: The mic in the top bar opens Crundi under it: click to keep it open, hover to peek, or hold the push-to-talk shortcut anywhere and let go to send. Change the shortcut in Settings, Voice assistant.

steps.title: "Hey Crundi" on the PC
steps.body: On the desktop app, Crundi can listen for "Hey Crundi" while the PC is on charge, entirely on the PC: nothing is sent anywhere until you speak to it. Turn it on from the tray or Settings, Voice assistant.
